## Findings
- claim-1: Source-2 gives only the distinct \((i,k,\mu)\)-bordered Jacobi–Trudi lemma and its matrix construction. [source-2@L1697-L1742|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: No supplied exact statement defines the requested \((\rho,a,b,j,q,r)\)-indexed congruence, its modulus, two shapes, or bordered-matrix order.
- claim-3: Therefore the requested determinant certificate cannot be established without inventing its target statement.
## Strategy
Inspected the supplied persisted audit [artifact `fa04411e0fa7ba004ba81ba1396855ab5f9d230e4bc3c6f862050cf56a5a2250`, L1–L30]. It records that the recovered task-313 statement is absent, including its congruence, modulus, parameter ranges, two shapes, and matrix ordering (L5–L16). The refreshed external text supplies only the unrelated Hopf identity [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702–705]. Source-2 supplies a distinct \((i,k,\mu)\)-lemma [source-2@L1697-L1742|claim=formal-document], which cannot be substituted.

## Gaps
The exact requested statement remains unavailable: no literal congruence or modulus; no definitions/ranges for \(\rho,a,b,j,q,r\); no two indexed shapes; and no prescribed bordered matrix row/column order. Consequently, no noninvented matrix, Laplace signs/minors, containment checks, or \(\rho=\varnothing\), \(a=0\) arguments can be given.

The named determinant certificate is **not established**.

## Next
Retrieve the persisted task-313 statement with immutable locator and bounded exact excerpts containing all missing definitions, conventions, identity, and ordering; only then derive the requested determinant proof directly.
